title: I got tired of AI characters forgetting who they are after 50 messages, so I built my own memory/identity system
author: OrionForgeEcosystem
selftext:
Hey everyone. For 18 months, I've been working on something that started as an annoyance of mine: every AI character I set up would slowly drift. The personality got flatter, it forgot things, and eventually it just sounded like generic ChatGPT.

So I built Orion Forge. The main idea is to separate who the character is from what it has experienced:

Identity (values, behavior, boundaries) lives in a read-only memory store, so it can't get overwritten by chat history

Experience gets its own memory store that grows as you talk

Each turn, the engine assembles both, plus knowledge notes and tools, into one clean system prompt

It runs in the browser, and you can use your own API keys or hosted models. There's no subscription. New accounts get $2 in credits, and hosted models cost 2× the raw API price (BYOK is free).

It's still early and I know there are rough edges. I'd really like feedback, especially on \[onboarding / the memory vault UX / whatever you're least sure about\].

Demo it here for free with no sign-in. [https://soulscript.orionforge.chat/demo](https://soulscript.orionforge.chat/demo)

Link to main site: [https://orionforge.chat](https://orionforge.chat/)

Happy to answer questions about how it works.
